verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents Checkout API, which lets customers pay on the merchant's own website or app without being redirected. It works across web and mobile with one API, and card data is captured securely with a simplified path to PCI. However, the evidence describes a flexible API, not pre-built customizable UI components. The only styling evidence (payment button appearance) belongs to the redirect-based Checkout Pro, so it does not count here. missing for 10: documented embeddable UI components/SDK widgets, evidence of visual customization options for on-site payment forms, independent or hands-on corroboration.
